title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Public Notice)
Where the Financial Services Commission determines a period for applying for acquisition of private investments or a period for payment of acquisition proceeds, the Commission shall give public notice thereof at least one month before the relevant period begins. [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
